## Basis (facts + the GL-GATE-07 non-US rule)

The underlying content is **Crown copyright**, published under the **Open Government Licence v3.0**
(OGL) — an attribution-only, reuse-permitting licence. Independently, this is a **non-US factual
compilation**, so the standing GL-GATE-07 disposition applies: the operator explicitly accepts the sui
generis database-right risk on non-US factual compilations (LEDGER GATE DECISIONS 2026-09-18). Per the
P29.3 gate answer, non-US → `LicenseRef-OperatorAccepted-DBRight`. The OGL v3.0 grant makes this
conservative (OGL alone would permit reuse with attribution); recording the operator-accepted DB-right
expression keeps the non-US basis visible and self-relicensable only, per the GL-GATE-07 rule.

## SPDX candidate

`LicenseRef-OperatorAccepted-DBRight` (`operator_accepted` compartment; self-relicensable only). The
OGL v3.0 Crown-copyright grant is recorded above as the corroborating open-licence basis.
